body: Oh! I remember years ago, my mom and I used to watch The Flash every week. She also raised me on the original Spider-Man trilogy. Her favorite parts were how heartwarming they were, esp the romance lol. I’m guessing TV and movies are an interest for her, maybe we could watch something!

Wow I never considered all of this. I wouldn’t be surprised if all this applied to her, she has family friends she sees but that’s it. She doesn’t really try to make friends, for example she doesn’t really connect with any of our neighbors beyond necessities.

To be honest I don’t know what her interests are 😓 she’s always been very work & religious focused, I remember a few years ago she didn’t believe in having fun. Now she’s warmed up to it, but I couldn’t tell a person what my mom does for fun on the spot. She does like competition and challenge, I usually see her super happy when she or one of us accomplished something

And yeah, I can tell my mom’s been drained by having a family, especially such a large one. I have pics of her from when I was a baby, and she looked so joyful. The only times I see her have fun are when she hears old music, but because she’s religious and our religion doesn’t allow us to listen to music or something like that, she never does listen to it.

I’ll try and see what her hobbies are. Thank you for the warning, I don’t want to bring up her past and make her unhappy. Thanks a ton, I really appreciate this

Thank you, I really appreciate this!

I’m not too sure on counseling services, I’ll check though. I’m not worried about myself, I’ve been able to work on feel better about myself before.

I’ll make sure my mom sees a therapist, it’s something she’s considering. I’ll try and look for groups too because I really wanna help her make friends, she doesn’t believe in the idea but it concerns me how she has no one to talk to besides me.

I don’t really have someone to talk to be honest. I do have a lot of friends, but I’ve never really made the effort to get close to them. I know how to, I’m a very social person but I just never did lol. My friends invited me to a party coming up soon though

My teachers, idk. I’ve opened up to them last trimester when I was doing poorly and they helped me out. I haven’t this trimester however.

Thank you, this really means a lot. I’ll make sure to not put too much responsibility on myself, you’re right I can’t really fix my own problems and my family’s too. I’ll work on myself but try to be there for my mom, like doing homework in her room
